title: Home purchase mortgage needs list
note: Core items follow the CFPB loan application packet; gift items follow the Fannie Mae Selling Guide. Lender, investor and loan-program rules add conditions.

cfpb.name: CFPB, Create a loan application packet

fnma.name: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-4.3-04, Personal Gifts

situations.gift-funds: Part of the down payment is a gift
situations.veteran: Servicemember or veteran using a VA loan
situations.counseling: Completed housing counseling or home buyer education

items.label: Proof of identity
items.detail: Typically a driver's license or non-driver ID.

items.label: Social Security number
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Pay stubs for the last 30 days
W-2 forms for the last two years
Signed federal tax returns for the last two years
Business tax returns and a year-to-date profit and loss statement
items.detail: Lender-specific; confirm what the program requires.

items.label: Two most recent bank statements
items.detail: All pages, every account used for the transaction.

items.label: Down payment source documentation
items.detail: Investment or savings statements showing at least two months' history of ownership.

items.label: Signed gift letter
items.detail: Must state the actual or maximum gift amount, that no repayment is expected, and the donor's name, address, telephone number and relationship to the borrower.

items.label: Evidence of the gift transfer
items.detail: For example the donor's check or withdrawal slip with the borrower's deposit slip, or evidence of an electronic transfer.

items.label: Mortgage statement, tax and insurance bills for each property owned
Housing counseling or home buyer education certificate
